provenance.launchPolicy: Pure prompt construction; no provider, file store, subprocess or tool execution. Prompt text grants no execution authority.
provenance.normalization: No text normalization; preserve tool order, workdir whitespace and access labels. Fixture invokes SDK helper and verifies it is the final full-agent instruction block. Native registry order and distinct mode/role instructions are not asserted equivalent.
